scheme_name: Medical Expenses-Treatment for Major Ailments Including Surgery
other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal.
Applicant must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
Member or his/her dependents must suffer from Cancer, Heart disease, Kidney disease, Tuberculosis, Eye disease, Leprosy, or Nerve disease.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹20,000 per annum, with a higher limit of ₹60,000 for operations related to heart, kidney, etc.
